question: Can you help me calculate the average number of new unicorn companies per year in the top industry from 2019 to 2021?
sql:
WITH top_industry AS (
  SELECT industry
  FROM companies_industries
  GROUP BY industry
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
unicorn_fintech_by_year AS (
  SELECT 
    cd.year_founded,
    COUNT(*) as unicorn_count
  FROM companies_funding cf
  JOIN companies_dates cd ON cf.company_id = cd.company_id
  JOIN companies_industries ci ON cf.company_id = ci.company_id
  CROSS JOIN top_industry ti
  WHERE cf.valuation >= 1000000000
    AND ci.industry = ti.industry
    AND cd.year_founded >= 2019
    AND cd.year_founded <= 2021
  GROUP BY cd.year_founded
)
SELECT 
  year_founded,
  unicorn_count,
  AVG(unicorn_count) OVER () as avg_per_year
FROM unicorn_fintech_by_year
ORDER BY year_founded;
